data.title: 鸿雪 · 稿纸上的停顿
data.description: 打字机上卷着半页稿纸。鸿雪读完刚写的句子，抽出一张便笺改了几个字，再重新把手放回键盘。
data.action: 坐在打字机前修改稿纸
data.camera: 中景，打字机与纸页同框
data.promptProse: Seated beside a tall sunlit study window overlooking snowy pines, Pozyomka pauses with her fingers hovering over the round keys of a vintage mechanical typewriter, deep in inspired thought. A fresh sheet of cotton paper is loaded in the carriage, with crumpled revision balls in a wicker bin, a ticking desk clock, and golden sunlight highlighting her silver-pink hair.
